review_kind: Independent non-author MCM reference-transfer, role-guidance and current synthetic-schematic acceptance

guidance_checks.observation: MCM paper pages are the main design references; the eleven general research images supply local topology/encoding rather than a new competition framework.

The profiles and current baseline explicitly allow useful containers, weak color grouping, domain glyphs, numerical scales, probability grids, full-page figures, multiple panels and conditional 3D. No two-color quota or universal no-box rule is introduced.
A/B/C briefs start from actual interfaces, fixed results and evidence roles; the generic shared-input ensemble is explicitly not the default whole-paper route.
Original scientific assertions, interval semantics and award names are not promoted to this task's verified facts. Current user structure, real scientific gates and result approval remain intact.
Four selected source pages were actually viewed by this reviewer, supporting the mapped claims below. The remaining five pages named by the author were not newly inspected by this reviewer.

Final role, baseline and scientific-grammar language limits exclusions to decorative or nonsemantic effects, explicitly preserving useful grouping and paper-derived domain structure. The minor wording recommendation is closed.

source_pages_actually_viewed.observation: Figure 1 contains task bands, intermediate environmental/trajectory/equipment/search views and chapter labels; preserving semantic grouping while enlarging small details is a faithful transfer.
Figures 9 and 10 first show one Bayesian-network block, then two temporal layers with distinct green cross-layer arrows. This supports component-before-composition and highlighting added links.

Figures 12 and 13 put a local actual/predicted comparison alongside the full training/test/forecast view. The original calls a band confidence interval and claims accuracy; neither statistical meaning nor accuracy has been independently accepted here.

Tables 8 and 9 use the same 0.3-0.7 correlation-threshold columns for total and gold outputs, including constant and varying country rows. The nearby text separately varies nominal interval levels. The proposed distinction and warning against blanket robustness are supported.
